stem: Root-zone EC is high in only the driest containers. Which conclusion is strongest?
choices: The nutrient recipe is proven excessive for every plant.
High EC identifies the accumulated ion.
The pattern supports investigating water volume/dryback and accumulation before making a room-wide nutrient change.
The dry containers prove a pathogen is present.
rationale: The pattern supports investigating water volume/dryback and accumulation before making a room-wide nutrient change.
